The '''Airam sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] near the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. The sector contained the vast [[Blair Cluster/Legends|Blair Cluster]].

==History==
The remote [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was home to the fiercely independent [[Airam Clans|clan-based]] [[Airam (group)|Airam]]. It was also a fair haven for criminals, [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and those who did not want to be found by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], such as the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="XvT" /> The Airam later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and formed the [[Airam Sector Force]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], elements of the Rebel Navy moved into the Airam sector in an attempt to gain a foothold there, and hide from the pursuing Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. During this [[Spreading the Rebellion|campaign]], they were forced to fight [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']], which had been sent by the Empire to pacify the Airam sector.<ref name="XvT" />

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Airam sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
